introduction: At this level, we explore the specific financial engines created by these blocs and the diplomatic mechanisms (like the Troika) that keep them running.

core_concepts.title: New Development Bank (NDB - The BRICS Bank)
core_concepts.description: Established during the 2014 'Fortaleza Summit' (Brazil). The NDB was created to challenge the dominance of the World Bank. Its headquarters is in 'Shanghai, China'. Its first President was India's K.V. Kamath.

core_concepts.title: Contingent Reserve Arrangement (CRA)
core_concepts.description: An emergency fund created by BRICS. If a member faces a dollar shortage (BoP crisis), they can borrow from the CRA instead of the IMF. It acts as a regional alternative to the IMF.

core_concepts.title: G20 'Troika' System
core_concepts.description: Since the G20 has no HQ, it is managed by the 'Troika'. The Troika consists of three countries: the previous president, the current president, and the next president. (e.g., In 2023, the Troika was Indonesia, India, and Brazil).

core_concepts.title: India's G20 Presidency (2023)
core_concepts.description: India hosted the G20 in 2023 under the theme: 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam' (One Earth, One Family, One Future). India's biggest achievement was making the 'African Union' (AU) a permanent member (the 21st member).

important_entities.name: Look East to Act East Policy
important_entities.significance: India launched the 'Look East' policy in 1992 to boost trade with ASEAN. In 2014, this was upgraded to the 'Act East' policy, which emphasizes security and cultural ties along with economic relations.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Students often confuse the HQs of the NDB (BRICS Bank) and the AIIB (Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank). 
NDB HQ = Shanghai. 
AIIB HQ = Beijing.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The foundation of the NDB was laid at the Fortaleza Summit in Brazil.

exam_strategy_tips: Questions on 'India's role in making AU a G20 member' and 'NDB Headquarters' are very frequent in Banking and SSC papers.
